verdict.rationale: Adyen documents issuing physical cards through the API by creating a paymentInstrument resource with a physical card type, and claims cards are 'fully customizable', which implies some personalization. The pack says nothing about the ordering and fulfilment side of the story. Missing for 10: documented custom card art/design configuration, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, and confirmation that Adyen handles card manufacturing and fulfilment end-to-end.
